purpose: Audit the already-metric Left Above Rim camera as the cheapest possible additional source-pixel identity witness before attempting a fifth camera calibration.

cissoko_identity.reason: Red #12 dunker is independently identifiable at F24 and remains temporally continuous across the adjacent frame sheet.

adams_player_identity.reason: The white blocking defender can be tracked as the defender contesting Cissoko in the exact-state sequence, but this does not by itself expose an auditable shoulder/torso landmark.

adams_block_shoulder.reason: At exact F24 the blocking defender's proximal shoulder/torso junction is substantially occluded by Cissoko. The extended arm is visible, but accepting a shoulder point would require inferring through the red player's body. Hidden anatomy is not an admissible identity landmark.

adams_sternum_or_pelvis.reason: No sufficiently unoccluded exact-state torso center is visible to provide an independent source-pixel Adams torso lock.

cissoko_shoulder_or_torso.reason: Cissoko's red upper body is visible enough to support identity-bearing torso/shoulder annotation if needed, subject to the normal reprojection and uncertainty gates.

decision: Do not use Left Above Rim as one of the two additional Adams shoulder identity views. It can strengthen Cissoko identity but does not solve the Adams bottleneck.
next_route: Prioritize Right Above Rim as the next metric-camera candidate because its exact-state sequence visibly separates the white blocking defender from red #12 and exposes proximal upper-body geometry. Calibrate it independently from player landmarks. Right Slash remains a secondary candidate. Do not weaken calibration or identity gates.
